description: Official event baseline and the denominator of eligible gatherings are pending. This bounded open-web pass cannot establish a complete event universe or support a no-event claim.

description: The Viasna January human-rights report at the exact URL https://spring96.org/en/news/114277 returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on one ordinary open after fresh gate and manual review; no body was received. This is an exact-URL denial only, not a publisher-wide hold.
required_followup: No retries, mirrors, alternates, or bypasses; retain as a URL-specific source gap.

description: The AP search-result lead could not be opened by the web tool; the tool returned an Internal Error stating that the URL was not accessible, with no observed HTTP status or body. This is a tool retrieval failure, not evidence of a publisher denial.
required_followup: No retry attempted; seek independent sources only through ordinary searches and fresh gates.

description: Belarusian- and Russian-language searches were run, but criminalization, self-censorship, arrests, exile, and removal of records can suppress reporting. Search results are not an independent measure of incidence.
required_followup: Seek independent archival, local and human-rights reporting after baseline review.

description: Queries covered broad English/Russian/Belarusian terms, weekly windows, sector and regional terms, and episode-boundary terms. This does not reproduce LexisNexis or systematic news-archive coverage; search engine indexing/ranking and query terms are incomplete.
required_followup: Repeat against approved systematic archives and official baseline.

description: No eligible candidate has verified threshold, physical execution, date, domestic target, episode start, or end. Reports of arrests/convictions for earlier peaceful protests are retrospective repression context, not a new January gathering.
